Name: Lnh's Expandable Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=5][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the entrustment of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#ff0000]可以扩建的农场[/color]
[/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]这是一个可以扩建很多次的农场，从小农场一步一步变成一个大农场，这是你努力工作得来的。
[/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=5]农场特色：[/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]1.可以多次扩建。

2.如果没有意外的话，联机也是没问题的。

3.所有地图都可以钓到淡水鱼。

4.拥有一个小型的泳池。（和罗宾拥有2颗心并且看完第一个事件，罗宾会为你建造）

5.所有地图都可以觅食，（每天大约10个觅食物品）每天还会刷新2个硬木桩。

6.所有土地都可以种植作物和放置建筑物。

7.自由度很高，自由规划，随心所欲。

8.几乎每次扩建农场后都会有奖励，由罗宾发放。

9.完成每一项社区中心献祭后的第二天会有奖励派送到农舍门口。

10.i18n构建，拥有中文，英文2种语言。（我的英文不好，是谷歌翻译成英文的，如果有人愿意重新翻译成英文或者是其他语言，随时欢迎！）
[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]如何扩建：
[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#ffff00]当你和罗宾拥有2颗心之后，前往罗宾农场扩建办事处（从农场传送图腾左上方的矿车进入）触发事件，之后你只需要带着足够的钱去那里，就可以触发扩建农场的事件，第一次扩建需要100000，之后每一次增加50000，（100000,150000,200000...）[/color]
[/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=5]配置选项：
[/size]
[/color][color=#00ff00][size=4]FarmReplacement：农场类型选择，默认替换标准农场，如果想要替换其他农场类型，第一步：修改农场类型，有效类型有：标准（[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4]Standard）, 森林（Forest）, 山顶（Hilltop）, 荒野（Wilderness）, 河流（Riverland）, 沙滩（Beach），第二步：保存，开启游戏，创建新游戏，选择你更改的农场类型。[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]EnableExpandableFarm：启用农场扩建计划，默认启用（true），如果你想要停止农场扩建，那么将true改成false
[/size][/color]
[color=#980000][size=5]如何安装：[/size][/color]
[color=#980000][size=4]你只需要安装这个农场mod和所需要的前置mod，将它们解压并放入mods文件夹即可。
前置mod：[/size][/color][color=#980000][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko的图表块[/url] ，[/size][/color][color=#980000][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]内容修补程序[/url] ，[/size][/color][color=#980000][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]农场管理类型（FTM）[/url] 
[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=4]有任何问题都可以给我留言，最后祝你玩的开心。
[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4]Farm that can be expanded.

This is a farm that can be expanded many times, step by step from a small farm to a larger farm with your hard work.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Farm Features:[/size]
[size=4]1. It can be expanded multiple times.

2. Should be compatible with multiplayer.

3. Freshwater fish can be caught on all maps.

4. Have a small swimming pool. (Have 2 hearts with Robin and watch the first event, Robin will build it for you)

5. All maps can be foraged, (around 10 forgeable  items per day) and 2 hardwood stumps will be refreshed every day.

6. Can grow crops and place buildings on the whole land.

7. High freedom, plan whatever you want.

8. There will be rewards from Robin almost every time the farm is expanded .

9. Rewards will be delivered to the front of the farmhouse on the next day after completing each community center bundle.

10.i18n build in with Chinese and English languages. (My English is not good, it was translated into English by Google, if anyone is willing to re-translate into English or other languages, welcome at any time!)[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5]How to expand:[/size]

[size=4]When you have 2 hearts with Robin, go to the Robin's Farm Expansion Office (enter from the mine cart at the north west of the farm warp statue) to trigger the event. After that, you only need to go there with enough money to trigger the farm expansion event, the first expansion needs 100000, and increasing by 50000, (100000, 150000, 200000...) each time thereafter. [/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=5]Configuration options:[/size]

[size=4]FarmReplacement:
Farm type selection, the standard farm is replaced by this mod by default, if you want to replace the other farm types, the first step: select that farm type here, valid ones are: Standard (Standard), Forest (Forest), Hilltop (Hilltop), Wilderness (Wilderness) , Riverland, Beach, Step 2: Save, start a new game and choose the type of farm that you have modified.

EnableExpandableFarm: Enable the farm expansion, enabled by default (true), if you want to disable the farm expansion, then change true to false[/size][/color]
